name: Vimwiki Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Copy your Vimwiki folder into the vault first, then run the preview command on that folder.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Vimwiki Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
